---
title: "Disturbance Explorer report"
output: html_document

---
  
###### Date: `r format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")`

This document report the disturbed and undisturbed areas for a specific study area. 

The application compiles a consistent set of spatial layers used to represent both natural and anthropogenic disturbances, as well as land use context. 

These layers are used within the app to visualize disturbance patterns, support comparisons, and enable cumulative effects assessment. It is possible for the user to add extra linear and/or areal disturbances as well as display elements as vector and/or raster format.

To generate and preview the report, upload a GeoPackage containing all required layers, run the analysis to generate the map, and select the map to be included in the report.
